name: Seduce Me: The Harem Episode
source:
"What are my true feelings?"

I've lived with the boys for a long time, adjusting to life with them by my side. Over time, I've grown to love all five of them.

How am I supposed to choose which incubus to love?

[From [url=https://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/seduce-me-the-otome-episode-series]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我真正的心意究竟是什么？”

我和他们已经一起生活了很久，也逐渐习惯了有他们陪伴的日子。随着时间流逝，我爱上了他们五个人。

我究竟该如何选择，要与哪一位男魅魔相爱？
